verdict.rationale: Abacum is a SaaS FP&A platform, not an agent, so it could plausibly publish an official MCP server and the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. The evidence covers in-product AI (AI Modeler), ERP/HRIS integrations and an Excel connector, none of which qualify, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.
